name: Nanjing University of Science and Technology
supervisors: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT)

evidence.summary: NJUST is one of the Seven Sons of National Defence, the seven universities run directly by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, which CSET found supply about three-quarters of the graduates hired by China’s defence-industry state-owned companies. Formed from the PLA’s Military Engineering Institute and later the PLA Artillery Engineering Institute, it counts "forging swords for the military" among its stated missions, and its leading discipline is weapons science and technology.
NJUST reports 10 defence-specialty disciplines (国防特色学科) and 13 national defence science and technology innovation teams.

NJUST hosts one national defence science, technology and industry innovation centre and co-builds three more, and two of its four campuses (Tangshan and Xuyi) focus on defence disciplines, research and testing.
NJUST reports to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and since 2018 has been co-constructed by MIIT, the Ministry of Education and Jiangsu province.
